pre_fix_reproductions.scenario: Quote XLSX original browser case under normal timing

root_cause.quote: The production helper removed the download anchor immediately and revoked its Blob URL on a zero-delay timer. The unmodified browser scenario failed under normal timing and passed when protocol tracing changed the timing; after deferring both cleanup operations by one second, the unchanged original scenario passed under normal timing and the saved workbook was valid. This A/B supports a browser-side Blob download lifecycle race.
root_cause.finance: The production helper clicked a detached anchor. The original 1440px case failed while the 390px case passed; after attaching the anchor and deferring removal and Blob URL revocation together by one second, both unchanged original cases passed under normal timing. This A/B supports a detached-anchor/download lifecycle race.
root_cause.protocol_limit: The instrumented pre-fix protocol runs completed rather than reproducing cancellation; no canceled Browser.downloadProgress event was captured. The causal attribution is based on normal-timing pre-fix reproduction plus the isolated lifecycle-only A/B fixes, not a fabricated canceled protocol event.
